title: "Teaching"
page-layout: full
toc: false

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One section per course, one listing per section.
#
# Grouping is BY FOLDER (teaching/bioee1610/, teaching/<next-course>/, ...), the
# same way the Team page separates current members from alumni. A file lives in
# exactly one course folder, so two sections can never show the same card and
# nothing can be silently missed by a typo in a front-matter field.
#
# Ordering within a course comes from each file's `weight:` field (low first).
#
# To add material to an existing course: drop a .qmd into that course's folder.
# Nothing here needs editing.
#
# To add a NEW course, three steps:
#   1. make the folder, e.g. teaching/bioee2510/
#   2. add a listing block below, copying the one for bioee1610 and changing
#      `id:` and `contents:`
#   3. add a `## Course name` section in the body with ::: {#that-id} under it
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
listing:
  - id: bioee1610
    contents: "teaching/bioee1610/*.qmd"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    fields: [image, title, description]
    sort: "weight asc"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---
